Messages.Author: GymNat1
Messages.Body:
>In a combat, can i Strike (as normal), play Blur to get additional
>strikes and AFTER those add.strikes can i play another Blur to get
>even more add.strikes?
>
>

No, you can only play or use one additional strike card per round of combat

Messages.Author: DOUGDWISE
Messages.Body:
>In a combat, can i Strike (as normal), play Blur to get additional
>strikes and AFTER those add.strikes can i play another Blur to get
>even more add.strikes?
>

>Thanks, but this is confusing me.
>.- Luis....@ip.pt
>
>

Don't know where it is in the V:tES rules but in the original Jyhad rulebook on
page 33, in the "Additional Strikes" section, the last sentence is "Only one
card may give an additional strike to a mnion for each round of combat."

So, no, you can't play a second blur in a round.

Doug Dunaway
"Artistically Inept Torreador"

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Luis P. Duarte wrote:
> In a combat, can i Strike (as normal), play Blur to get additional
> strikes and AFTER those add.strikes can i play another Blur to get
> even more add.strikes?

No. Rulebook, section 21.4: "Only one additional strike card may be
used by a minion for each round of combat."
